name: bakery-monorepo
description: A ridiculously fast, zero-config full-stack framework built on Bun.
author: obillekyle

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:orm && bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:create && bun run typecheck:plugins && bun run typecheck:app && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:plugins: bunx tsc -p packages/plugins/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/plugins/analytics/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/plugins/dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/plugins/db-explorer/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:app: bunx tsc -p apps/example/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p apps/starter/tsconfig.json --noEmit
